free_tier.stated: Free plan at USD 0 a month: free access to v0, deploy apps to Vercel, Design Mode, GitHub sync and a 7 message a day limit; the pricing page lists no included credits
free_tier.notes: recurring daily allowance of 7 messages. The docs also say new users under a one-time Free credit offer receive USD 5 once per account and existing Free users keep a USD 5 monthly allowance, and that the pricing page shows the current signup offer; the pricing page read lists no credits, so whether a new Free account holds credits is unverified: behind a sign-up

per_object_cap.stated: 5 MB per chat attachment and 10 MB per ZIP upload on Free, against 20 MB and 50 MB on paid plans

retention.stated: not applicable: the unit is a generation allowance, not stored bytes

egress.terms: not applicable: apps deploy to Vercel, whose own Hobby allowances apply to what is served

interface_detail: REST API at https://api.v0.dev with the v0 npm SDK (v0 in v2, v0-sdk in v1), authenticated by an API key made in the v0 settings; a remote MCP server at https://v0.app/api/mcp that signs in by OAuth, and AI SDK tools (@v0-sdk/ai-tools). Chats are created and continued by calls such as chats.create and messages.send, with async variants, so a generation can run with no browser. The docs list no command-line client (the /docs/cli page does not exist). Whether a Free account may mint an API key was not seen: the keys page answered a login wall
tooling: the user calls the v0 REST API or installs the npm package v0 (or the v1 package v0-sdk) in a program they run, or adds https://v0.app/api/mcp as a remote MCP server to an MCP-capable client; the apps v0 builds deploy to Vercel
chaining: the Free plan builds the app and deploys it to a Vercel account, whose Hobby plan hosts it (see compute/vercel and egress/vercel-hobby); the daily message count is the only generation budget on Free

limits.value: 7 messages a day on Free; the API reports the remaining count and the reset time in the dailyLimit object of GET /v1/rate-limits
5 MB per chat attachment and 10 MB per ZIP upload on Free

limits_note: 7 messages a day, counted per message and not per token; the per-token model price table is what credit-billed plans pay, and the Free plan shows no credit balance on the pricing page. New accounts get a 48-hour grace period during which the daily count is not tracked
binding_note: the 7 messages a day limit decides how much a Free account can generate

identity_cost.detail: a Vercel account: the v0 FAQ says a Vercel account gives access to v0, and the Vercel sign-up page offers Continue with Google, GitHub, Apple, ChatGPT and Email; no phone or card field was seen on that page, and the steps after it are unverified: behind a sign-up

reliability_note: not stated on the pages read: no outage, suspension or throttling event is recorded
confidence_note: plan, message limit, model prices and API surfaces are quoted from first-party pages read on 2026-11-02; API key creation on a Free account and the credit balance a new Free account holds were behind a login and are unverified
